card_collection_surface_label: Example card/collection posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded card/collection surface for official voter-information routes that present answer-bearing choices as repeated cards, tiles, or collection items.

card_sets.card_role_note: Answer-bearing set of cards for vote-by-mail, early voting, and Election Day options.
card_sets.grouping_note: The set is exposed as a reviewed list of distinct items rather than a visually grouped but semantically flat tile wall.
card_sets.heading_and_status_note: Each card heading names the voting mode directly and any status badge is explained in adjacent text.
card_sets.primary_action_note: Each card uses a distinct destination label so voters can tell whether the action opens instructions, a locator, or a help route.
card_sets.responsive_scan_order_note: When cards wrap to a single column, the same answer priority remains visible and the current recommended path does not disappear below unrelated options.

group_structure_note: Repeated answer-bearing items are grouped explicitly so the card set remains understandable as a list of choices rather than decorative blocks.
heading_hierarchy_note: Card headings and surrounding page headings preserve a logical hierarchy that makes each answer lane distinguishable.
card_link_purpose_note: Visible action labels and surrounding card context make each destination understandable without opening several cards experimentally.
badge_and_status_semantics_note: Badges, dates, icons, and metadata supplement rather than replace the text that explains why a card is current, unavailable, or exceptional.
whole_card_click_target_note: If the card itself is clickable, the heading, teaser, and actual destination remain aligned and no conflicting secondary target obscures the main next step.
responsive_grid_note: Reviewed desktop and narrow layouts preserve meaningful scan order and do not silently demote the controlling card when the grid wraps.
same_destination_consistency_note: Cards that lead to the same destination use consistent labeling while different destinations remain visibly distinguishable.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Each card-bearing route preserves a visible path back to broader official help or overview content when no card fully resolves the voter’s case.
